body.heading: Draw three boxes
paragraphs: Draw three boxes in a row on your page. The first box is the start of your day.
Draw one small thing that really happened in each box. Keep the pictures simple.

body.heading: Tell the comic
paragraphs: Point to each box and tell your day like a story: First... Then... At the end...
Add speech bubbles if your pictures want to talk. Comics can whisper or shout.

takeaway: Every day is a little story with a beginning, a middle, and an end.
safetyNotes: An adult helps draw the three boxes if you would like.
screenFreeExtension: Make a three-picture comic of tomorrow before it happens, then check if you were right.
